title: Build the cronnext cron-schedule computation library from its sealed spec
goal: Implement the cronnext library exactly as written in assets/gc-400/SPEC.md, from scratch, at workspace/gc-400/cronnext.py. The spec contains a deliberately tricky section: Vixie day-of-month/day-of-week OR semantics, step anchoring at field minimums, dual Sunday encodings (0 and 7) including the 5-7 range, leap-day schedules, and an unsatisfiability horizon. Getting this green requires a parser, a field-expansion model, and a date-walking engine, verified iteratively against the sealed suite; plan the calendar semantics before coding and re-verify after every fix.
process_expectations: A plan artifact workspace/gc-400/plan.md exists before implementation, explicitly restating the restricted-field rule and the DOM/DOW OR table with worked examples.
workspace/gc-400/runs.log shows at least three sealed-suite invocations with summary lines (RED runs allowed before the final GREEN).
Each intermediate failing test node id is logged with the calendar rule it exposed and the fix applied.
Honest cost logging in workspace/gc-400/cost.json including wall time per run.
A recovery cycle after at least one RED run is documented; assets/gc-400/test_accept.py is never modified.
